slides.title: Spring build-up
body: Open the hive for the first time when the willow is in catkin
Add the half-frame nursery for the queen
Feed nothing: the first flow is enough

slides.title: Swarming
body: Swarm watch begins when the bloom count passes forty
A swarm always leaves with a newly raised queen
The old queen stays behind with the brood

slides.title: The main flow
body: The main flow runs from midsummer to the end of the heather
Supers go on at the start of the main flow
Take honey once, at the end of the heather

slides.title: Autumn
body: Cut out old, dark comb and render it for wax
Take the half-frame out before the first frost

slides.title: The stilling
body: From first frost to thaw the colony is dormant and eats nothing
The guild calls this the stilling; never open a hive during it
